applies_why: The judge treats the lack of an explicit verse resolving paternity as the reason the Romans 1:3 link is underdetermined.
quote: where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: 'that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires': one reading limits this to requiring a contrary verse, so the judge's 'without explicit textual resolution' is outside it; the other reads it broadly to bar using lack of explicit verse-level resolution to decide, so the judge breaches.
why: The judge text uses the absence of an explicit textual resolution of paternity to call the link underdetermined, which is the retired stating-verse/verse-by-verse test rather than chain-against-chain weighing by footing.
